items.title: Kenny Burrell — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I really liked the way Coleman Hawkins and Lester Young…Herschel Evans, those kind of guys.

ctx.x: You don't remember what sparked it? Or…

I think I remember what sparked it was listening to the big bands like Count Basie and Duke Ellington. And what attracted me at first was the tenor saxophone and I really liked the way Coleman Hawkins and Lester Young…Herschel Evans, those kind of guys. And, well, I’d say, “That’s really, that’s a masculine, really a beautiful thing.” And so I’d say, “I’m going to get it.” But again, as fate would have it, we were poor. I didn’t have, my father was dead and my mother was working two jobs. If she could get two…
